entities.name: Islamic Cultural Centre of Ireland
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
The Islamic Cultural Centre of Ireland is an Islamic 
complex, including a mosque, in Clonskeagh, Dublin, Ireland. It is funded by the al-Maktoum Foundation of Dubai and has a Sunni orientation.
